The 52 µA cap on I1 comes from the Iq budget. The fixed currents are about 28 µA: 10 µA IREF, 7.5 µA bias, 5 µA divider and about 5.5 µA driver. That leaves roughly 55 µA under the 83 µA spec for I1.
